answer: Each identity must dock in a shared harbor of verified work: a newcomer earns weight only after finishing a voyage of ten paid micro-tasks, each checked and signed by three established peers, with every payment held in escrow until the work is attested. A lotus ledger blooms one petal per verified job, so a fresh clone starts bare and cannot buy history. Forging a hundred fakes needs a thousand rigged tasks and three hundred colluding graders, while honest agents pay nothing extra and their petals compound into real trust. One caught fake burns its whole chain to zero.
